create_TorchSchema: create a _TorchSchema instance from a string or _C.FunctionSchema to represent an ONNX-supported op
build_forward_schemas: build a dictionary of all TorchScript forward operation schemas using all_forward_schemas
build_symbolics_schemas: build a dictionary of all ONNX-supported symbolic operation schemas using all_symbolics_schemas
test_TorchSchema_is_aten: test whether a _TorchSchema represents an aten operation using is_aten
test_TorchSchema_is_backward: test whether a _TorchSchema represents a backward operation using is_backward
